summary: InMode Ltd. furnished a 6-K on September 16, 2026 reporting that the unsolicited, non-binding acquisition proposal from M.N. Business Strategy Ltd., submitted to the Board on June 17, 2026, expired by its terms on September 15, 2026. No agreement was reached on that proposal or any other transaction. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed in the excerpt. The Israeli-domiciled, Nasdaq-listed issuer (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K current report) made no structural commitments. Watch for a revised bid, strategic alternatives review, or shares trading back to standalone fundamentals given the failed approach.
